200.description:
Contract specifications for one CME product from CmeWS: codes (Globex, clearing, ClearPort), contract unit, price quotation, minimum price fluctuation, listed contracts, settlement method and procedures, trading hours and termination of trading, as plain text.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `codes` | object |  |
| `contract_unit` | string |  |
| `guid` | string |  |
| `listed_contracts` | object[] |  |
| `minimum_price_fluctuation` | object[] |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix milliseconds when this program observed the source. |
| `price_quotation` | string |  |
| `product_group` | string |  |
| `product_id` | number |  |
| `product_name` | string |  |
| `product_sub_group` | string |  |
| `settlement_method` | string |  |
| `settlement_procedures` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `termination_of_trading` | object[] |  |
| `trading_hours` | object[] |  |
| `underlying` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

listed_contracts.label: Default
listed_contracts.text: Monthly contracts listed for 60 consecutive months

minimum_price_fluctuation.label: Default
minimum_price_fluctuation.text: 1/2 of one basis point (0.005) = $20.835 Beginning at 5:00 p.m. CT on the Sunday preceding the first business day of the spot month: 1/4 of one basis point (0.0025) = $10.4175

value.price_quotation: Contract IMM Index = 100 minus R R = arithmetic average of daily effective federal funds rates during contract month. E.g., a price quote of 92.75 signifies an average daily rate of 7.25 percent per annum.
value.settlement_procedures: Expiring contracts are cash settled against the average daily Fed Funds overnight rate for the delivery month, rounded to the nearest one-tenth of one basis point. Final settlement occurs on the first business day following the last trading day. The daily Fed Funds overnight rate is calculated and reported by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Settlement Procedures

termination_of_trading.label: Default
termination_of_trading.text: Trading terminates on the last business day of the contract month.

trading_hours.label: CME Globex
trading_hours.text: Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.ET (5:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. CT). Monday - Thursday 5:00 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. ET (4:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. CT) daily maintenance period.

trading_hours.label: CME ClearPort
trading_hours.text: Sunday 5:00 p.m. - Friday 5:45 p.m. CT with no reporting Monday - Thursday from 5:45 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. CT

200.description:
CME FedWatch (QuikStrike) current view: the upcoming FOMC meeting tabs and, for the default (nearest) meeting, the 30 Day Fed Funds contract behind it, the ease / no change / hike probabilities and the target-rate probability table compared with one day, one week and one month earlier. Data is derived from prior settlements and updates once per trading day (data_as_of). Mints a QuikStrike session (two requests: entry page with the cmegroup.com referer, then the view).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data_as_of` | string | FedWatch's own stamp, e.g. '26 Sep 2026 07:24:49 CT'. |
| `meetings` | object[] |  |
| `note` | string | FedWatch's footnote about projected meeting dates, when shown. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix milliseconds when this program observed the source. |
| `selected_meeting` | object |  |
| `source_url` | string | The CME FedWatch tool page that embeds the QuikStrike view. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.note: 1/1/2028 and forward are projected meeting dates

post.description: Use for the probabilities of a specific meeting (take latest) or for how they evolved over time. Meeting dates come from fedwatch_meetings.

from.description: Inclusive first history date to return, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

meeting_date.description: FOMC meeting date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-12-09), one of the dates fedwatch_meetings lists. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

to.description: Inclusive last history date to return, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Daily history of CME FedWatch target-rate probabilities for one FOMC meeting, from the QuikStrike MeetingExport CSV: one row per trading day since the contract was modelled, each with the probability of every target range FedWatch modelled that day; latest is the most recent row in the returned window. Optionally restricted to a from/to date window. A date that is not an FOMC meeting FedWatch tracks is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `rows` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string |  |
| `probabilities` | object[] | Only the ranges FedWatch modelled on that day; blank CSV cells are omitted. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:

| `expiration_code` | string |  |

| `updated` | string | ISO timestamp of the last quote update. |

200.description:
Daily futures settlements for one CME product on one trade date from CmeWS: settle, open/high/low/last, change, volume and open interest per contract month plus the total row, and the list of trade dates CME currently offers. The response contains the tool result directly.

| `low` | string | Exactly as CME publishes it (string); null where CME prints '-'. |
